content.thinking: I'll back-transform the log2(TPM+1) matrix (18,979 genes × 73 pre-treatment samples) to linear TPM using 2^x−1, keeping original values without rescaling since column sums are low due to gene set subsetting. I'll flag sample `8_PD1_PRE` for its unusually low complexity (~4.6k genes above 1 TPM).

input.command:
mkdir -p results/inputs results/scripts && Rscript -e '
x <- read.delim("data/Gide_log2TPM.txt", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
tpm <- 2^as.matrix(x) - 1; tpm[tpm < 0] <- 0
write.csv(data.frame(gene=rownames(tpm), tpm, check.names=FALSE), "results/inputs/Gide_TPM_linear.csv", row.names=FALSE)
c <- read.table("data/colData_all.txt", header=TRUE); c <- c[c$Cohort=="Gide",]; rownames(c) <- c$rna_id
c <- c[colnames(tpm),]; write.csv(c, "results/inputs/Gide_coldata.csv")
cat("done", dim(tpm), "\n"); print(table(c$Response, c$Therapy))'; head -c 300 results/inputs/Gide_TPM_linear.csv
input.description: Write linear TPM and Gide clinical CSVs

field_glossary.kernel: The raw sender x receiver x patient communication kernel -- abundance-weighted signaling strength between every cell-type pair, per patient.
field_glossary.kernel_norm: Only present if norm=True: a null-model kernel built by giving every structurally possible ligand-receptor pair equal uniform strength instead of its real measured expression. Dividing kernel by kernel_norm cancels out cell-type abundance and topology, leaving a composition-independent specificity/enrichment score -- 'is this pair communicating more than expected from network structure and cell abundance alone', not just raw absolute strength (which is confounded by how common the cell types are).
field_glossary.features: The derived per-patient feature matrix (or, with multiple communication_type entries, a named list of feature matrices) -- one column per cell-type combination and motif type. This is what you'd feed into pipeML-server for downstream modeling.

field_glossary.kernel: The raw sender x receiver x patient communication kernel -- abundance-weighted signaling strength between every cell-type pair, per patient.
field_glossary.kernel_norm: Only present if norm=True: a null-model kernel built by giving every structurally possible ligand-receptor pair equal uniform strength instead of its real measured expression. Dividing kernel by kernel_norm cancels out cell-type abundance and topology, leaving a composition-independent specificity/enrichment score -- 'is this pair communicating more than expected from network structure and cell abundance alone', not just raw absolute strength (which is confounded by how common the cell types are).
field_glossary.features: The derived per-patient feature matrix (or, with multiple communication_type entries, a named list of feature matrices) -- one column per cell-type combination and motif type. This is what you'd feed into pipeML-server for downstream modeling.

content.thinking: RaCInG 0.3.0 is available in R, so I'll run `compute_racing_montecarlo` directly in the background using the server's exact parameters (10,000 cells, degree 20, 20 graphs/patient, all 5 motif types, raw magnitudes) across 14 cores, saving the script in `results/scripts/` for reproducibility.

input.content:
# Monte Carlo RaCInG run for the Gide cohort (all 73 patients).
# Same arguments the RaCInG-server MCP tool (run_racing_montecarlo) passes to
# RaCInG::compute_racing_montecarlo; run directly in R so the multi-hour job can
# run in the background. Pilot: ~63 s per graph per patient (all 5 motif types).
#
# Usage: Rscript run_montecarlo.R <input_rds> <out_dir> <n_graphs> <ncores>
suppressMessages(library(RaCInG))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_rds <- args[1]
out_dir <- args[2]
n_graphs <- as.integer(args[3])
ncores <- as.integer(args[4])

dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "Results"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
setwd(out_dir)
set.seed(123)

input_data <- readRDS(input_rds)
t0 <- Sys.time()
res <- compute_racing_montecarlo(
  input_data = input_data,
  output_folder = "Results/",
  fun_LR = min,
  file_name = "Gide_MC",
  nPatients = "all",
  communication_type = c("D", "W", "TT", "CT", "GSCC"),
  Ncells = 10000,
  Ngraphs = n_graphs,
  Ndegree = 20,
  remove_direction = TRUE,
  norm = FALSE,
  ncores = ncores
)
saveRDS(res, "result.rds")
cat("Finished in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")

===== computeTriangles 
function (kernel, cell_names, patient_names, Dcell = NULL, unifKernel = NULL, 
    norm = FALSE, bundle = TRUE, zero_threshold = 1) 
{
    n_patients <- dim(kernel)[3]
    n_cells <- length(cell_names)
    kernel_mat <- matrix(kernel, nrow = n_cells * n_cells, ncol = n_patients)
    unif_mat <- if (!is.null(unifKernel)) 
        matrix(unifKernel, nrow = n_cells * n_cells, ncol = n_patients)
    else NULL
    idx2 <- function(a, b) a + (b - 1L) * n_cells
    get_val <- function(mat, a, b) mat[idx2(a, b), , drop = FALSE]
    weight_or_ratio_vec <- function(num_mat, den_mat, i_idx, 
        j_idx, k_idx) {
        if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) {
            value <- num_mat/den_mat
            value[is.nan(value)] <- 1
            value
        }
        else {
            Dmat <- as.matrix(Dcell)
            value <- num_mat
            for (p in seq_len(n_patients)) {
                value[, p] <- Dmat[p, i_idx] * Dmat[p, j_idx] * 
                  Dmat[p, k_idx] * num_mat[, p]
            }
            value
        }
    }
    if (bundle) {
        grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_cells), function(ii) {
            do.call(rbind, lapply(ii:n_cells, function(jj) {
                expand.grid(i = ii, j = jj, k = jj:n_cells)
            }))
        }))
        i <- grid$i
        j <- grid$j
        k <- grid$k
        Kij <- get_val(kernel_mat, i, j)
        Kjk <- get_val(kernel_mat, j, k)
        Kki <- get_val(kernel_mat, k, i)
        Kik <- get_val(kernel_mat, i, k)
        Kkj <- get_val(kernel_mat, k, j)
        Kji <- get_val(kernel_mat, j, i)
        num <- Kij * Kjk * Kki + Kij * Kjk * Kik + Kij * Kkj * 
            Kik + Kij * Kkj * Kki + Kji * Kkj * Kki + Kji * Kjk * 
            Kki + Kji * Kjk * Kik + Kji * Kkj * Kik
        possible <- rowSums(num != 0) > 0
        if (!all(possible)) {
            i <- i[possible]
            j <- j[possible]
            k <- k[possible]
            Kij <- Kij[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            Kjk <- Kjk[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            Kki <- Kki[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            Kik <- Kik[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            Kkj <- Kkj[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            Kji <- Kji[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            num <- num[possible, , drop = FALSE]
        }
        den <- NULL
        if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) {
            UKij <- get_val(unif_mat, i, j)
            UKjk <- get_val(unif_mat, j, k)
            UKki <- get_val(unif_mat, k, i)
            UKik <- get_val(unif_mat, i, k)
            UKkj <- get_val(unif_mat, k, j)
            UKji <- get_val(unif_mat, j, i)
            den <- UKij * UKjk * UKki + UKij * UKjk * UKik + 
                UKij * UKkj * UKik + UKij * UKkj * UKki + UKji * 
                UKkj * UKki + UKji * UKjk * UKki + UKji * UKjk * 
                UKik + UKji * UKkj * UKik
        }
        value <- weight_or_ratio_vec(num, den, i, j, k)
        out <- t(value)
        colnames(out) <- paste0("Tr_", cell_names[i], "_", cell_names[j], 
            "_", cell_names[k])
    }
    else {
        grid <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(n_cells), j = seq_len(n_cells), 
            k = seq_len(n_cells))
        i_full <- grid$i
        j_full <- grid$j
        k_full <- grid$k
        Kij <- get_val(kernel_mat, i_full, j_full)
        Kjk <- get_val(kernel_mat, j_full, k_full)
        UKij <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) 
            get_val(unif_mat, i_full, j_full)
        else NULL
        UKjk <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) 
            get_val(unif_mat, j_full, k_full)
        else NULL
        Kik <- get_val(kernel_mat, i_full, k_full)
        num_tt <- Kij * Kjk * Kik
        rm(Kik)
        possible_tt <- rowSums(num_tt != 0) > 0
        i_tt <- i_full[possible_tt]
        j_tt <- j_full[possible_tt]
        k_tt <- k_full[possible_tt]
        num_tt <- num_tt[possible_tt, , drop = FALSE]
        den_tt <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) {
            (UKij * UKjk * get_val(unif_mat, i_full, k_full))[possible_tt, 
                , drop = FALSE]
        }
        else NULL
        value_tt <- weight_or_ratio_vec(num_tt, den_tt, i_tt, 
            j_tt, k_tt)
        rm(num_tt, den_tt)
        gc(FALSE)
        colnames_tt <- paste0("TT_", cell_names[i_tt], "_", cell_names[j_tt], 
            "_", cell_names[k_tt])
        keep_ct <- i_full <= j_full & j_full <= k_full
        i_ct0 <- i_full[keep_ct]
        j_ct0 <- j_full[keep_ct]
        k_ct0 <- k_full[keep_ct]
        Kki <- get_val(kernel_mat, k_full, i_full)
        num_ct <- (Kij * Kjk * Kki)[keep_ct, , drop = FALSE]
        den_ct_full <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) {
            (UKij * UKjk * get_val(unif_mat, k_full, i_full))[keep_ct, 
                , drop = FALSE]
        }
        else NULL
        rm(Kki, Kij, Kjk, UKij, UKjk)
        possible_ct <- rowSums(num_ct != 0) > 0
        i_ct <- i_ct0[possible_ct]
        j_ct <- j_ct0[possible_ct]
        k_ct <- k_ct0[possible_ct]
        num_ct <- num_ct[possible_ct, , drop = FALSE]
        den_ct <- if (!is.null(den_ct_full)) 
            den_ct_full[possible_ct, , drop = FALSE]
        else NULL
        value_ct <- weight_or_ratio_vec(num_ct, den_ct, i_ct, 
            j_ct, k_ct)
        rm(num_ct, den_ct)
        gc(FALSE)
        colnames_ct <- paste0("CT_", cell_names[i_ct], "_", cell_names[j_ct], 
            "_", cell_names[k_ct])
        out <- t(rbind(value_tt, value_ct))
        colnames(out) <- c(colnames_tt, colnames_ct)
    }
    df <- as.data.frame(out)
    rownames(df) <- patient_names
    df <- df[, colMeans(df == 0) < zero_threshold, drop = FALSE]
    return(df)
}

function (kernel, unifKernel = NULL, cells, Dcell = NULL, bundle = TRUE, 
    patient_names = NULL, zero_threshold = 1) 
{
    n_celltypes <- length(cells)
    n_patients <- dim(kernel)[3]
    df_list <- list()
    for (i in 1:n_celltypes) {
        for (j in if (bundle) 
            i:n_celltypes
        else 1:n_celltypes) {
            colname <- paste0("Dir_", cells[i], "_", cells[j])
            if (!is.null(unifKernel)) {
                value <- if (bundle) {
                  (kernel[i, j, ] + kernel[j, i, ])/(unifKernel[i, 
                    j, ] + unifKernel[j, i, ])
                }
                else {
                  kernel[i, j, ]/unifKernel[i, j, ]
                }
                value[is.nan(value)] <- 0
            }
            else {
                value <- if (bundle) {
                  Dcell[, i] * Dcell[, j] * (kernel[i, j, ] + 
                    kernel[j, i, ])
                }
                else {
                  Dcell[, i] * Dcell[, j] * kernel[i, j, ]
                }
            }
            df_list[[colname]] <- value
        }
    }
    df <- as.data.frame(df_list)
    rownames(df) <- if (!is.null(patient_names)) 
        patient_names
    else paste0("Patient_", 1:n_patients)
    df <- df[, colMeans(df == 0) < zero_threshold, drop = FALSE]
    return(df)
}

        Kij <- get_val(kernel_mat, i_full, j_full)
        Kjk <- get_val(kernel_mat, j_full, k_full)
        UKij <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) 
            get_val(unif_mat, i_full, j_full)
        else NULL
        UKjk <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) 
            get_val(unif_mat, j_full, k_full)
        else NULL
        Kik <- get_val(kernel_mat, i_full, k_full)
        num_tt <- Kij * Kjk * Kik
        rm(Kik)
        possible_tt <- rowSums(num_tt != 0) > 0
        i_tt <- i_full[possible_tt]
        j_tt <- j_full[possible_tt]
        k_tt <- k_full[possible_tt]
        num_tt <- num_tt[possible_tt, , drop = FALSE]
        den_tt <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) {
            (UKij * UKjk * get_val(unif_mat, i_full, k_full))[possible_tt, 
                , drop = FALSE]
        }
        else NULL
        value_tt <- weight_or_ratio_vec(num_tt, den_tt, i_tt, 
            j_tt, k_tt)
        rm(num_tt, den_tt)
        gc(FALSE)
        colnames_tt <- paste0("TT_", cell_names[i_tt], "_", cell_names[j_tt], 
            "_", cell_names[k_tt])
        keep_ct <- i_full <= j_full & j_full <= k_full
        i_ct0 <- i_full[keep_ct]
        j_ct0 <- j_full[keep_ct]
        k_ct0 <- k_full[keep_ct]
        Kki <- get_val(kernel_mat, k_full, i_full)
        num_ct <- (Kij * Kjk * Kki)[keep_ct, , drop = FALSE]
        den_ct_full <- if (norm && !is.null(unifKernel)) {
            (UKij * UKjk * get_val(unif_mat, k_full, i_full))[keep_ct, 
                , drop = FALSE]
        }
        else NULL
        rm(Kki, Kij, Kjk, UKij, UKjk)
        possible_ct <- rowSums(num_ct != 0) > 0
        i_ct <- i_ct0[possible_ct]
        j_ct <- j_ct0[possible_ct]
        k_ct <- k_ct0[possible_ct]
        num_ct <- num_ct[possible_ct, , drop = FALSE]
        den_ct <- if (!is.null(den_ct_full)) 
            den_ct_full[possible_ct, , drop = FALSE]
        else NULL
        value_ct <- weight_or_ratio_vec(num_ct, den_ct, i_ct, 
            j_ct, k_ct)
        rm(num_ct, den_ct)
        gc(FALSE)
        colnames_ct <- paste0("CT_", cell_names[i_ct], "_", cell_names[j_ct], 
            "_", cell_names[k_ct])
        out <- t(rbind(value_tt, value_ct))
        colnames(out) <- c(colnames_tt, colnames_ct)
    }
    df <- as.data.frame(out)
    rownames(df) <- patient_names
    df <- df[, colMeans(df == 0) < zero_threshold, drop = FALSE]
    return(df)

function (kernel, unifKernel = NULL, cells, Dcell = NULL, bundle = TRUE, 
    patient_names = NULL, zero_threshold = 1) 
{
    n_celltypes <- length(cells)
    n_patients <- dim(kernel)[3]
    df_list <- list()
    for (i in 1:n_celltypes) {
        for (j in if (bundle) 
            i:n_celltypes
        else 1:n_celltypes) {
            colname <- paste0("Dir_", cells[i], "_", cells[j])
            if (!is.null(unifKernel)) {
                value <- if (bundle) {
                  (kernel[i, j, ] + kernel[j, i, ])/(unifKernel[i, 
                    j, ] + unifKernel[j, i, ])
                }
                else {
                  kernel[i, j, ]/unifKernel[i, j, ]
                }
                value[is.nan(value)] <- 0
            }
            else {
                value <- if (bundle) {
                  Dcell[, i] * Dcell[, j] * (kernel[i, j, ] + 
                    kernel[j, i, ])
                }
                else {
                  Dcell[, i] * Dcell[, j] * kernel[i, j, ]
                }
            }
            df_list[[colname]] <- value
        }
    }
    df <- as.data.frame(df_list)
    rownames(df) <- if (!is.null(patient_names)) 
        patient_names
    else paste0("Patient_", 1:n_patients)
    df <- df[, colMeans(df == 0) < zero_threshold, drop = FALSE]
    return(df)
}

Now I'll build the parameter-sensitivity inputs (alternative fun_lr, 5/20 TPM thresholds, immune-only renormalization) before relaunching Monte Carlo.

field_glossary.kernel: The raw sender x receiver x patient communication kernel -- abundance-weighted signaling strength between every cell-type pair, per patient.
field_glossary.kernel_norm: Only present if norm=True: a null-model kernel built by giving every structurally possible ligand-receptor pair equal uniform strength instead of its real measured expression. Dividing kernel by kernel_norm cancels out cell-type abundance and topology, leaving a composition-independent specificity/enrichment score -- 'is this pair communicating more than expected from network structure and cell abundance alone', not just raw absolute strength (which is confounded by how common the cell types are).
field_glossary.features: The derived per-patient feature matrix (or, with multiple communication_type entries, a named list of feature matrices) -- one column per cell-type combination and motif type. This is what you'd feed into pipeML-server for downstream modeling.

field_glossary.kernel: The raw sender x receiver x patient communication kernel -- abundance-weighted signaling strength between every cell-type pair, per patient.
field_glossary.kernel_norm: Only present if norm=True: a null-model kernel built by giving every structurally possible ligand-receptor pair equal uniform strength instead of its real measured expression. Dividing kernel by kernel_norm cancels out cell-type abundance and topology, leaving a composition-independent specificity/enrichment score -- 'is this pair communicating more than expected from network structure and cell abundance alone', not just raw absolute strength (which is confounded by how common the cell types are).
field_glossary.features: The derived per-patient feature matrix (or, with multiple communication_type entries, a named list of feature matrices) -- one column per cell-type combination and motif type. This is what you'd feed into pipeML-server for downstream modeling.

function (kernel, unifKernel = NULL, cells, Dcell = NULL, bundle = TRUE, 
    patient_names = NULL, zero_threshold = 1) 
{
    n_celltypes <- length(cells)
    n_patients <- dim(kernel)[3]
    if (bundle) {
        grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_celltypes), function(jj) {
            expand.grid(i = seq_len(n_celltypes), j = jj, k = jj:n_celltypes)
        }))
    }
    else {
        grid <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(n_celltypes), j = seq_len(n_celltypes), 
            k = seq_len(n_celltypes))
    }
    i <- grid$i
    j <- grid$j
    k <- grid$k
    kernel_mat <- matrix(kernel, nrow = n_celltypes * n_celltypes, 
        ncol = n_patients)
    idx2 <- function(a, b) a + (b - 1L) * n_celltypes
    Kij <- kernel_mat[idx2(i, j), , drop = FALSE]
    Kjk <- kernel_mat[idx2(j, k), , drop = FALSE]
    if (bundle) {
        Kkj0 <- kernel_mat[idx2(k, j), , drop = FALSE]
        Kji0 <- kernel_mat[idx2(j, i), , drop = FALSE]
        struct_core <- Kij * Kjk + Kkj0 * Kji0
    }
    else {
        struct_core <- Kij * Kjk
    }
    possible <- rowSums(struct_core != 0) > 0
    if (!all(possible)) {
        i <- i[possible]
        j <- j[possible]
        k <- k[possible]
        Kij <- Kij[possible, , drop = FALSE]
        Kjk <- Kjk[possible, , drop = FALSE]
        if (bundle) {
            Kkj0 <- Kkj0[possible, , drop = FALSE]
            Kji0 <- Kji0[possible, , drop = FALSE]
        }
    }
    rm(struct_core)
    if (!is.null(unifKernel)) {
        unif_mat <- matrix(unifKernel, nrow = n_celltypes * n_celltypes, 
            ncol = n_patients)
        UKij <- unif_mat[idx2(i, j), , drop = FALSE]
        UKjk <- unif_mat[idx2(j, k), , drop = FALSE]
        if (bundle) {
            UKkj <- unif_mat[idx2(k, j), , drop = FALSE]
            UKji <- unif_mat[idx2(j, i), , drop = FALSE]
            num <- Kij * Kjk + Kkj0 * Kji0
            den <- UKij * UKjk + UKkj * UKji
        }
        else {
            num <- Kij * Kjk
            den <- UKij * UKjk
        }
        value <- num/den
        value[is.nan(value)] <- 0

# Shared helpers for the Gide RaCInG analysis.
suppressMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})

RES <- "/home/marcelo.hurtado/Documents/tme_analysis/78d8073c6b/work/results"

short <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Quantiseq_TIL10_", "", x)
  x <- gsub("CD4.non.regulatory", "CD4", x)
  x <- gsub("CD4.regulatory", "Treg", x)
  x <- gsub("CD8.cells", "CD8", x)
  x <- gsub("Dendritic.cells", "DC", x)
  x <- gsub("Macrophages.M1", "M1", x)
  x <- gsub("Macrophages.M2", "M2", x)
  x <- gsub("Monocytes", "Mono", x)
  x <- gsub("Neutrophils", "Neutro", x)
  x <- gsub("NK.cells", "NK", x)
  x <- gsub("B.cells", "B", x)
  x
}

read_feat <- function(path) {
  x <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(x) <- short(colnames(x))
  as.matrix(x)
}

# Load a RaCInG input object and the kernel arrays of a raw (norm=FALSE) and a
# normalized (norm=TRUE) kernel run computed from it.
load_kernel <- function(inputs_rds, raw_rds, norm_rds) {
  inp <- readRDS(inputs_rds)
  raw <- readRDS(raw_rds)
  nrm <- readRDS(norm_rds)
  ct <- short(inp$celltypes)
  C <- inp$Cmatrix
  colnames(C) <- short(colnames(C))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(C), ct))
  K <- raw$kernel
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(K, nrm$kernel)))
  dimnames(K) <- list(ct, ct, rownames(C))
  U <- nrm$kernel_norm
  dimnames(U) <- dimnames(K)
  list(C = C, K = K, U = U, ct = ct, patients = rownames(C))
}

# Expected fraction of all communication edges running sender i -> receiver j:
# C_i * C_j * K_ij (sums to ~1 per patient). Returns sender x receiver x patient.
edge_fraction <- function(kl) {
  E <- kl$K
  for (p in seq_along(kl$patients)) {
    c <- kl$C[p, ]
    E[, , p] <- outer(c, c) * kl$K[, , p]
  }
  E
}

# Wedges (two-hop relays leaf_i <-> hub_j <-> leaf_k, both directions bundled),
# with the formula of RaCInG::calculateWedges but enumerating every hub with
# every unordered leaf pair {i, k} (i <= k). RaCInG's kernel implementation
# enumerates k >= j instead, which drops/duplicates leaf pairs depending on the
# hub's position in the cell-type order.
wedges <- function(kl, norm = FALSE) {
  ct <- kl$ct
  n <- length(ct)
  grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(j)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i)
      if (i <= n) data.frame(i = i, j = j, k = i:n)))))
  out <- sapply(seq_along(kl$patients), function(p) {
    K <- kl$K[, , p]
    num <- K[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)] +
      K[cbind(grid$k, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$i)]
    if (norm) {
      U <- kl$U[, , p]
      den <- U[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * U[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)] +
        U[cbind(grid$k, grid$j)] * U[cbind(grid$j, grid$i)]
      v <- num / den
      v[is.nan(v)] <- 0
      v
    } else {
      c <- kl$C[p, ]
      c[grid$i] * c[grid$j] * c[grid$k] * num
    }
  })
  out <- t(out)
  dimnames(out) <- list(kl$patients,
                        paste0("W_", ct[grid$i], "_", ct[grid$j], "_", ct[grid$k]))
  out
}

# Cohort summary of a patients x features matrix of non-negative raw values:
# each patient's values as a share of that patient's total.
share_summary <- function(X, top = 5) {
  S <- X / rowSums(X)
  rk <- t(apply(-S, 1, rank, ties.method = "min"))
  data.table(
    feature = colnames(S),

# Most common cell-cell communication patterns in the Gide cohort, from the
# deterministic RaCInG kernel (main analysis: quanTIseq composition incl. tumor,
# 0.1% abundance floor, fun_LR = min, expr_threshold = 10 TPM).
source("/home/marcelo.hurtado/Documents/tme_analysis/78d8073c6b/work/results/scripts/common.R")
suppressMessages({
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cluster)
  library(patchwork)
})
set.seed(1)

M <- file.path(RES, "main")
OUT <- file.path(M, "05_patterns")
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE)

kl <- load_kernel(file.path(M, "01_inputs/result.rds"),
                  file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result.rds"),
                  file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result.rds"))
coldata <- read.csv(file.path(RES, "inputs/Gide_coldata.csv"), row.names = 1)
coldata <- coldata[kl$patients, ]
ct <- kl$ct

## ---- Features (raw = abundance-weighted magnitude; norm = enrichment ratio) ----
feat <- list(
  raw = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = FALSE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  ),
  norm = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = TRUE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  )
)
# Kernel TT output holds trust triangles (TT_) and cycle triangles (CT_).
for (s in names(feat)) {
  tt <- feat[[s]]$TT
  feat[[s]]$TT <- tt[, grepl("^TT_", colnames(tt))]
  feat[[s]]$CT <- tt[, grepl("^CT_", colnames(tt))]
}
saveRDS(feat, file.path(OUT, "kernel_features_corrected.rds"))
for (s in names(feat)) for (f in names(feat[[s]]))
  fwrite(data.table(patient = rownames(feat[[s]][[f]]), feat[[s]][[f]]),
         file.path(OUT, sprintf("features_%s_%s.csv", s, f)))

## ---- Cohort-level summaries ----
summ <- list()
for (f in c("D", "W", "TT", "CT")) {
  a <- share_summary(feat$raw[[f]])
  b <- enrich_summary(feat$norm[[f]])
  setnames(b, c("q25", "q75"), c("enrich_q25", "enrich_q75"))
  m <- merge(a, b[, !"pct_patients_nonzero"], by = "feature", all = TRUE)
  m <- m[order(-median_share)]

  summ[[f]] <- m
  fwrite(m, file.path(OUT, sprintf("cohort_summary_%s.csv", f)))
}

gscc <- feat$raw$GSCC
gscc_tab <- data.table(
  cell_type = sub("GSCC_", "", colnames(gscc)),
  median_fraction_in_GSCC = apply(gscc, 2, median),
  q25 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .25), q75 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .75),
  median_enrichment = apply(feat$norm$GSCC, 2, median),
  pct_patients_enriched = 100 * colMeans(feat$norm$GSCC > 1)
)[order(-median_fraction_in_GSCC)]
fwrite(gscc_tab, file.path(OUT, "cohort_summary_GSCC.csv"))

## ---- Cell-type roles ----
E <- edge_fraction(kl)
Eshare <- sweep(E, 3, apply(E, 3, sum), "/")
med_E <- apply(Eshare, 1:2, median)
fwrite(data.table(sender = rownames(med_E), med_E), file.path(OUT, "median_edge_share_sender_x_receiver.csv"))

Wraw <- feat$raw$W
hub <- sub("^W_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(Wraw))
Wsh <- Wraw / rowSums(Wraw)
hub_share <- sapply(ct, function(h) rowSums(Wsh[, hub == h, drop = FALSE]))
roles <- data.table(
  cell_type = ct,
  median_abundance = apply(kl$C, 2, median),
  median_out_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(1, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_in_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(2, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_relay_share = apply(hub_share, 2, median)
)
roles[, out_over_abundance := median_out_share / median_abundance]
roles[, in_over_abundance := median_in_share / median_abundance]
roles <- roles[order(-median_relay_share)]
fwrite(roles, file.path(OUT, "cell_type_roles.csv"))

## ---- Patient communication phenotypes (clustering on direct-edge shares) ----
Dsh <- feat$raw$D / rowSums(feat$raw$D)
H <- sqrt(Dsh)                          # Hellinger embedding of compositions
dH <- dist(H)
hc <- hclust(dH, method = "ward.D2")
sil <- sapply(2:6, function(k) mean(silhouette(cutree(hc, k), dH)[, 3]))
names(sil) <- 2:6
k_best <- as.integer(names(which.max(sil)))
cl <- cutree(hc, k_best)

# Bootstrap stability (clusterboot-style): resample patients, recluster, and
# record for each original cluster the best Jaccard match.
boot_jac <- replicate(200, {
  idx <- sort(unique(sample(seq_len(nrow(H)), replace = TRUE)))
  cb <- cutree(hclust(dist(H[idx, ]), method = "ward.D2"), k_best)
  sapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
    a <- idx[cl[idx] == g]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cb), function(h) {
      b <- idx[cb == h]
      length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
    }))
  })
})
boot_jac <- matrix(boot_jac, nrow = k_best)
clus_stab <- data.table(
  cluster = seq_len(k_best), n = as.integer(table(cl)),
  mean_jaccard = rowMeans(boot_jac, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_boot_jaccard_gt_0.75 = 100 * rowMeans(boot_jac > 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Characterize clusters: mean shares of top direct edges, composition, response.
top_edges <- summ$D$feature[1:12]
clus_desc <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
  w <- cl == g
  diffs <- colMeans(Dsh[w, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(Dsh[!w, , drop = FALSE])
  data.table(cluster = g,
             defining_edges_up = paste(names(sort(diffs, decreasing = TRUE))[1:4], collapse = "; "),
             top_abundant = paste(names(sort(colMeans(kl$C[w, , drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = "; "),
             median_tumor_fraction = median(kl$C[w, "Cancer"]),
             n_R = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "R"), n_NR = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "NR"))
}))
clus_desc <- merge(clus_stab, clus_desc, by = "cluster")
fwrite(clus_desc, file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_clusters.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(patient = names(cl), original_id = coldata$original_id, cluster = cl,
                  Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy),
       file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_assignment.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(k = 2:6, mean_silhouette = sil), file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_silhouette.csv"))
resp_p <- fisher.test(table(cl, coldata$Response))$p.value

## ---- Figures ----
lab <- function(x) gsub("_", " - ", sub("^(Dir|W|TT|CT)_", "", x))

topD <- summ$D[1:15]
p1 <- ggplot(topD, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of patient's direct communication (median, IQR)",
       title = "Dominant direct interactions (raw kernel)")
enr <- summ$D[pct_patients_nonzero > 50][order(-median_enrichment)][1:15]
p2 <- ggplot(enr, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_enrichment), y = median_enrichment)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = enrich_q25, ymax = enrich_q75), width = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Enrichment over uniform-LR baseline (median, IQR)",
       title = "Most specific direct interactions (normalized kernel)")
save_plot(p1 + p2, file.path(OUT, "fig_direct_top_interactions.pdf"), 14, 6)

pdf(file.path(OUT, "fig_sender_receiver_median_edge_share.pdf"), 7, 6)
pheatmap(100 * med_E, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.1f", main = "Median % of communication edges (row = sender, col = receiver)")
dev.off()

topW <- summ$W[1:15]
p3 <- ggplot(topW, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "seagreen") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "leaf - hub - leaf", y = "% of patient's wedges (median, IQR)", title = "Dominant relays (wedges)")
rl <- melt(roles[, .(cell_type, median_abundance, median_out_share, median_in_share, median_relay_share)],
           id.vars = "cell_type")
p4 <- ggplot(rl, aes(x = reorder(cell_type, value), y = 100 * value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% (cohort median)", fill = NULL, title = "Cell-type roles")
save_plot(p3 + p4, file.path(OUT, "fig_wedges_and_roles.pdf"), 14, 6)

ann <- data.frame(Phenotype = factor(cl), Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy,
                  row.names = names(cl))
pdf(file.path(OUT, "fig_patient_phenotypes_heatmap.pdf"), 12, 11)
pheatmap(t(100 * Dsh[, summ$D$feature[1:25]]), cluster_cols = hc, cutree_cols = k_best,
         annotation_col = ann, labels_row = lab(summ$D$feature[1:25]), show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = sprintf("Direct-communication profiles (%% of patient total), k=%d phenotypes", k_best))
dev.off()

## ---- Console report ----
cat("\n== Top direct interactions (share of patient's direct communication) ==\n")
print(summ$D[1:12, .(feature, median_share = round(100 * median_share, 1),
                     pct_top5 = round(pct_patients_top5), median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2),
                     pct_enriched = round(pct_patients_enriched))])
cat("\n== Most enriched direct interactions (nonzero in >50% patients) ==\n")
print(enr[1:12, .(feature, median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2),
                  pct_enriched = round(pct_patients_enriched), median_share = round(100 * median_share, 2))])
cat("\n== Top wedges ==\n")
print(summ$W[1:10, .(feature, median_share = round(100 * median_share, 1), pct_top5 = round(pct_patients_top5),
                     median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2))])
cat("\n== Top trust triangles ==\n")
print(summ$TT[1:8, .(feature, median_share = round(100 * median_share, 1), pct_top5 = round(pct_patients_top5),
                     median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2))])
cat("\n== Top cycle triangles ==\n")
print(summ$CT[1:5, .(feature, median_share = round(100 * median_share, 1), pct_top5 = round(pct_patients_top5),
                     median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2))])
cat("\n== GSCC ==\n"); print(gscc_tab, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Cell-type roles ==\n"); print(roles, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Patient phenotypes ==\nsilhouette:", round(sil, 3), "\n"); print(clus_desc)
cat("Fisher test phenotype vs response p =", signif(resp_p, 3), "\n")

short <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Quantiseq_TIL10_", "", x)
  x <- gsub("CD4.non.regulatory", "CD4", x)
  x <- gsub("CD4.regulatory", "Treg", x)

  x <- gsub("Macrophages.M1", "M1", x)
  x <- gsub("Macrophages.M2", "M2", x)
  x <- gsub("Monocytes", "Mono", x)
  x <- gsub("Neutrophils", "Neutro", x)

read_feat <- function(path) {

# Load a RaCInG input object and the kernel arrays of a raw (norm=FALSE) and a
# normalized (norm=TRUE) kernel run computed from it.
load_kernel <- function(inputs_rds, raw_rds, norm_rds) {
  inp <- readRDS(inputs_rds)
  raw <- readRDS(raw_rds)
  nrm <- readRDS(norm_rds)
  ct <- short(inp$celltypes)
  C <- inp$Cmatrix
  colnames(C) <- short(colnames(C))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(C), ct))
  K <- raw$kernel
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(K, nrm$kernel)))
  dimnames(K) <- list(ct, ct, rownames(C))
  U <- nrm$kernel_norm
  dimnames(U) <- dimnames(K)
  list(C = C, K = K, U = U, ct = ct, patients = rownames(C))
}

# Expected fraction of all communication edges running sender i -> receiver j:
# C_i * C_j * K_ij (sums to ~1 per patient). Returns sender x receiver x patient.
edge_fraction <- function(kl) {
  E <- kl$K
  for (p in seq_along(kl$patients)) {
    c <- kl$C[p, ]
    E[, , p] <- outer(c, c) * kl$K[, , p]
  }
  E
}

# Wedges (two-hop relays leaf_i <-> hub_j <-> leaf_k, both directions bundled),
# with the formula of RaCInG::calculateWedges but enumerating every hub with
# every unordered leaf pair {i, k} (i <= k). RaCInG's kernel implementation
# enumerates k >= j instead, which drops/duplicates leaf pairs depending on the
# hub's position in the cell-type order.
wedges <- function(kl, norm = FALSE) {
  ct <- kl$ct
  n <- length(ct)
  grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(j)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i)
      data.frame(i = i, j = j, k = i:n)))))
  out <- sapply(seq_along(kl$patients), function(p) {
    K <- kl$K[, , p]
    num <- K[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)] +
      K[cbind(grid$k, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$i)]
    if (norm) {
      U <- kl$U[, , p]
      den <- U[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * U[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)] +
        U[cbind(grid$k, grid$j)] * U[cbind(grid$j, grid$i)]
      v <- num / den
      v[is.nan(v)] <- 0
      v
    } else {
      c <- kl$C[p, ]
      c[grid$i] * c[grid$j] * c[grid$k] * num
    }
  })
  out <- t(out)
  dimnames(out) <- list(kl$patients,
                        paste0("W_", ct[grid$i], "_", ct[grid$j], "_", ct[grid$k]))
  out
}

# Cohort summary of a patients x features matrix of non-negative raw values:
# each patient's values as a share of that patient's total.
share_summary <- function(X, top = 5) {
  S <- X / rowSums(X)
  rk <- t(apply(-S, 1, rank, ties.method = "min"))
  data.table(
    feature = colnames(S),
    median_share = apply(S, 2, median),
    mean_share = colMeans(S),
    q25 = apply(S, 2, quantile, 0.25),
    q75 = apply(S, 2, quantile, 0.75),
    pct_patients_top5 = 100 * colMeans(rk <= top),
    pct_patients_nonzero = 100 * colMeans(X > 0)
  )[order(-median_share)]
}

# Cohort summary of enrichment ratios (normalized kernel features).
enrich_summary <- function(X) {
  data.table(
    feature = colnames(X),
    median_enrichment = apply(X, 2, median),
    q25 = apply(X, 2, quantile, 0.25),
    q75 = apply(X, 2, quantile, 0.75),
    pct_patients_enriched = 100 * colMeans(X > 1),
    pct_patients_nonzero = 100 * colMeans(X > 0)
  )[order(-median_enrichment)]
}

save_plot <- function(p, file, w = 8, h = 6) {
  ggsave(file, p, width = w, height = h)
  invisible(file)
}

# Most common cell-cell communication patterns in the Gide cohort, from the
# deterministic RaCInG kernel (main analysis: quanTIseq composition incl. tumor,
# 0.1% abundance floor, fun_LR = min, expr_threshold = 10 TPM).
source("/home/marcelo.hurtado/Documents/tme_analysis/78d8073c6b/work/results/scripts/common.R")
suppressMessages({
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cluster)
  library(patchwork)
})
set.seed(1)

M <- file.path(RES, "main")
OUT <- file.path(M, "05_patterns")
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE)

kl <- load_kernel(file.path(M, "01_inputs/result.rds"),
                  file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result.rds"),
                  file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result.rds"))
coldata <- read.csv(file.path(RES, "inputs/Gide_coldata.csv"), row.names = 1)
coldata <- coldata[kl$patients, ]
ct <- kl$ct

## ---- Features (raw = abundance-weighted magnitude; norm = enrichment ratio) ----
feat <- list(
  raw = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = FALSE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  ),
  norm = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = TRUE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  )
)
# Kernel TT output holds trust triangles (TT_) and cycle triangles (CT_).
for (s in names(feat)) {
  tt <- feat[[s]]$TT
  feat[[s]]$TT <- tt[, grepl("^TT_", colnames(tt))]
  feat[[s]]$CT <- tt[, grepl("^CT_", colnames(tt))]
}
saveRDS(feat, file.path(OUT, "kernel_features_corrected.rds"))
for (s in names(feat)) for (f in names(feat[[s]]))
  fwrite(data.table(patient = rownames(feat[[s]][[f]]), feat[[s]][[f]]),
         file.path(OUT, sprintf("features_%s_%s.csv", s, f)))

## ---- Cohort-level summaries ----
summ <- list()
for (f in c("D", "W", "TT", "CT")) {
  a <- share_summary(feat$raw[[f]])
  b <- enrich_summary(feat$norm[[f]])
  setnames(b, c("q25", "q75"), c("enrich_q25", "enrich_q75"))
  m <- merge(a, b[, !"pct_patients_nonzero"], by = "feature", all = TRUE)
  m <- m[order(-median_share)]
  m[, rank_share := seq_len(.N)]
  summ[[f]] <- m
  fwrite(m, file.path(OUT, sprintf("cohort_summary_%s.csv", f)))
}

gscc <- feat$raw$GSCC
gscc_tab <- data.table(
  cell_type = sub("GSCC_", "", colnames(gscc)),
  median_fraction_in_GSCC = apply(gscc, 2, median),
  q25 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .25), q75 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .75),
  median_enrichment = apply(feat$norm$GSCC, 2, median),
  pct_patients_enriched = 100 * colMeans(feat$norm$GSCC > 1)
)[order(-median_fraction_in_GSCC)]
fwrite(gscc_tab, file.path(OUT, "cohort_summary_GSCC.csv"))

## ---- Cell-type roles ----
E <- edge_fraction(kl)
Eshare <- sweep(E, 3, apply(E, 3, sum), "/")
med_E <- apply(Eshare, 1:2, median)
fwrite(data.table(sender = rownames(med_E), med_E), file.path(OUT, "median_edge_share_sender_x_receiver.csv"))

Wraw <- feat$raw$W
hub <- sub("^W_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(Wraw))
Wsh <- Wraw / rowSums(Wraw)
hub_share <- sapply(ct, function(h) rowSums(Wsh[, hub == h, drop = FALSE]))
roles <- data.table(
  cell_type = ct,
  median_abundance = apply(kl$C, 2, median),
  median_out_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(1, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_in_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(2, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_relay_share = apply(hub_share, 2, median)
)
roles[, out_over_abundance := median_out_share / median_abundance]
roles[, in_over_abundance := median_in_share / median_abundance]
roles <- roles[order(-median_relay_share)]
fwrite(roles, file.path(OUT, "cell_type_roles.csv"))

## ---- Patient communication phenotypes (clustering on direct-edge shares) ----
Dsh <- feat$raw$D / rowSums(feat$raw$D)
H <- sqrt(Dsh)                          # Hellinger embedding of compositions
dH <- dist(H)
hc <- hclust(dH, method = "ward.D2")
sil <- sapply(2:6, function(k) mean(silhouette(cutree(hc, k), dH)[, 3]))
names(sil) <- 2:6
k_best <- as.integer(names(which.max(sil)))
cl <- cutree(hc, k_best)

# Bootstrap stability (clusterboot-style): resample patients, recluster, and
# record for each original cluster the best Jaccard match.
boot_jac <- replicate(200, {
  idx <- sort(unique(sample(seq_len(nrow(H)), replace = TRUE)))
  cb <- cutree(hclust(dist(H[idx, ]), method = "ward.D2"), k_best)
  sapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
    a <- idx[cl[idx] == g]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cb), function(h) {
      b <- idx[cb == h]
      length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
    }))
  })
})
boot_jac <- matrix(boot_jac, nrow = k_best)
clus_stab <- data.table(
  cluster = seq_len(k_best), n = as.integer(table(cl)),
  mean_jaccard = rowMeans(boot_jac, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_boot_jaccard_gt_0.75 = 100 * rowMeans(boot_jac > 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Characterize clusters: mean shares of top direct edges, composition, response.
top_edges <- summ$D$feature[1:12]
clus_desc <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
  w <- cl == g
  diffs <- colMeans(Dsh[w, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(Dsh[!w, , drop = FALSE])
  data.table(cluster = g,
             defining_edges_up = paste(names(sort(diffs, decreasing = TRUE))[1:4], collapse = "; "),
             top_abundant = paste(names(sort(colMeans(kl$C[w, , drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = "; "),
             median_tumor_fraction = median(kl$C[w, "Cancer"]),
             n_R = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "R"), n_NR = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "NR"))
}))
clus_desc <- merge(clus_stab, clus_desc, by = "cluster")
fwrite(clus_desc, file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_clusters.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(patient = names(cl), original_id = coldata$original_id, cluster = cl,
                  Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy),
       file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_assignment.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(k = 2:6, mean_silhouette = sil), file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_silhouette.csv"))
resp_p <- fisher.test(table(cl, coldata$Response))$p.value

## ---- Figures ----
lab <- function(x) gsub("_", " - ", sub("^(Dir|W|TT|CT)_", "", x))

topD <- summ$D[1:15]
p1 <- ggplot(topD, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of patient's direct communication (median, IQR)",
       title = "Dominant direct interactions (raw kernel)")
enr <- summ$D[pct_patients_nonzero > 50][order(-median_enrichment)][1:15]
p2 <- ggplot(enr, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_enrichment), y = median_enrichment)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = enrich_q25, ymax = enrich_q75), width = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Enrichment over uniform-LR baseline (median, IQR)",
       title = "Most specific direct interactions (normalized kernel)")
save_plot(p1 + p2, file.path(OUT, "fig_direct_top_interactions.pdf"), 14, 6)

pdf(file.path(OUT, "fig_sender_receiver_median_edge_share.pdf"), 7, 6)
pheatmap(100 * med_E, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.1f", main = "Median % of communication edges (row = sender, col = receiver)")
dev.off()

topW <- summ$W[1:15]
p3 <- ggplot(topW, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +

  labs(x = "leaf - hub - leaf", y = "% of patient's wedges (median, IQR)", title = "Dominant relays (wedges)")
rl <- melt(roles[, .(cell_type, median_abundance, median_out_share, median_in_share, median_relay_share)],
           id.vars = "cell_type")
p4 <- ggplot(rl, aes(x = reorder(cell_type, value), y = 100 * value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% (cohort median)", fill = NULL, title = "Cell-type roles")
save_plot(p3 + p4, file.path(OUT, "fig_wedges_and_roles.pdf"), 14, 6)

ann <- data.frame(Phenotype = factor(cl), Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy,

pdf(file.path(OUT, "fig_patient_phenotypes_heatmap.pdf"), 12, 11)
pheatmap(t(100 * Dsh[, summ$D$feature[1:25]]), cluster_cols = hc, cutree_cols = k_best,

dev.off()

## ---- Console report ----
cat("\n== Top direct interactions (share of patient's direct communication) ==\n")
print(summ$D[1:12, .(feature, median_share = round(100 * median_share, 1),
                     pct_top5 = round(pct_patients_top5), median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2),
                     pct_enriched = round(pct_patients_enriched))])
cat("\n== Most enriched direct interactions (nonzero in >50% patients) ==\n")
print(enr[1:12, .(feature, median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2),

# Robustness of the kernel-derived communication patterns to
#  (1) RaCInG parameters / model choices (sensitivity scenarios S1-S4),
#  (2) cohort resampling (patient bootstrap) and outlier samples,
#  (3) the patient phenotype clustering.
# Monte Carlo (simulation) robustness is assessed separately in 03_robustness_montecarlo.R.
source("/home/marcelo.hurtado/Documents/tme_analysis/78d8073c6b/work/results/scripts/common.R")
suppressMessages(library(cluster))
set.seed(2)

OUT <- file.path(RES, "robustness")
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE)
TOPN <- 10

load_scenario <- function(dir, inputs = file.path(dir, "inputs")) {
  kl <- load_kernel(inputs, file.path(dir, "kernel_raw/result.rds"), file.path(dir, "kernel_norm/result.rds"))
  D <- read_feat(file.path(dir, "kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv"))
  E <- edge_fraction(kl)
  i <- which(kl$ct == colnames(kl$C)[1]); j <- which(kl$ct == colnames(kl$C)[2])
  chk <- unname(D[, paste0("Dir_", kl$ct[i], "_", kl$ct[j])]) - unname(E[i, j, ] + E[j, i, ])
  stopifnot(max(abs(chk)) < 1e-10)   # Cmatrix CSV order matches the kernel's cell types
  list(D_raw = D,
       D_norm = read_feat(file.path(dir, "kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
       W_raw = wedges(kl, FALSE), W_norm = wedges(kl, TRUE))
}

scen_dirs <- c(
  main = file.path(RES, "main"),
  S1_funLR_prod = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S1_funLR_prod"),
  S2_exprThr5 = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S2_exprThr5"),
  S3_exprThr20 = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S3_exprThr20"),
  S4_immuneOnly = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S4_immuneOnly")
)
sc <- list()
sc$main <- {
  m <- file.path(RES, "main")
  kl <- load_kernel(file.path(m, "01_inputs"), file.path(m, "02_kernel_raw/result.rds"), file.path(m, "03_kernel_norm/result.rds"))
  list(D_raw = read_feat(file.path(m, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv")),
       D_norm = read_feat(file.path(m, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
       W_raw = wedges(kl, FALSE), W_norm = wedges(kl, TRUE))
}
for (s in names(scen_dirs)[-1]) sc[[s]] <- load_scenario(scen_dirs[[s]])

is_share <- function(ft) grepl("_raw$", ft)
cohort_stat <- function(X, ft) if (is_share(ft)) apply(X / rowSums(X), 2, median) else apply(X, 2, median)

## ---- (1) Sensitivity scenarios vs main ----
sens <- list()
for (s in names(sc)[-1]) for (ft in c("D_raw", "D_norm", "W_raw", "W_norm")) {
  A <- sc$main[[ft]]; B <- sc[[s]][[ft]]
  feats <- intersect(colnames(A), colnames(B))
  if (s == "S4_immuneOnly") feats <- feats[!grepl("Cancer", feats)]
  A <- A[, feats]; B <- B[rownames(A), feats]
  if (is_share(ft)) { A <- A / rowSums(A); B <- B / rowSums(B) }   # shares within the compared set
  a <- apply(A, 2, median); b <- apply(B, 2, median)
  topA <- names(sort(a, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN]; topB <- names(sort(b, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN]
  per_feat <- sapply(feats, function(f) suppressWarnings(cor(A[, f], B[, f], method = "spearman")))
  sens[[length(sens) + 1]] <- data.table(
    scenario = s, feature_type = ft, n_features_compared = length(feats),
    cohort_rank_spearman = cor(a, b, method = "spearman"),
    top10_overlap = length(intersect(topA, topB)),
    main_top3_ranks_in_scenario = paste(match(topA[1:3], names(sort(b, decreasing = TRUE))), collapse = ","),
    median_per_feature_patient_spearman = median(per_feat, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_features_patient_spearman_gt_0.8 = 100 * mean(per_feat > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE))
}
sens <- rbindlist(sens)
fwrite(sens, file.path(OUT, "sensitivity_scenarios_vs_main.csv"))

## ---- (2) Patient bootstrap and outlier exclusion (main analysis) ----
boot_tab <- list()
for (ft in c("D_raw", "D_norm", "W_raw", "W_norm")) {
  X <- sc$main[[ft]]
  if (!is_share(ft)) X <- X[, colMeans(X > 0) > 0.5]       # enrichment only where defined in most patients
  full <- cohort_stat(X, ft)
  top <- names(sort(full, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN]
  B <- replicate(1000, {
    st <- cohort_stat(X[sample(nrow(X), replace = TRUE), ], ft)
    r <- rank(-st, ties.method = "min")
    r[top]
  })
  rownames(B) <- top
  boot_tab[[ft]] <- data.table(feature_type = ft, feature = top, full_rank = 1:TOPN,
                               boot_median_rank = apply(B, 1, median),
                               boot_rank_95CI = apply(B, 1, function(r) paste(quantile(r, c(.025, .975)), collapse = "-")),
                               pct_boot_in_top10 = 100 * rowMeans(B <= TOPN),
                               pct_boot_same_rank = 100 * rowMeans(B == seq_len(TOPN)))
}
boot_tab <- rbindlist(boot_tab)
fwrite(boot_tab, file.path(OUT, "bootstrap_top10_stability.csv"))

outliers <- c("Gide_8_PD1_PRE",      # low library complexity (~4.6k genes > 1 TPM)
              "Gide_36_PD1_PRE",     # no tumor fraction, 65% neutrophils
              "Gide_33_ipiPD1_PRE")  # extreme raw triangle counts (rare NK)
loo <- rbindlist(lapply(c("D_raw", "D_norm", "W_raw", "W_norm"), function(ft) {
  X <- sc$main[[ft]]
  if (!is_share(ft)) X <- X[, colMeans(X > 0) > 0.5]
  a <- cohort_stat(X, ft); b <- cohort_stat(X[!rownames(X) %in% outliers, ], ft)
  data.table(feature_type = ft, cohort_rank_spearman = cor(a, b, method = "spearman"),
             top10_overlap = length(intersect(names(sort(a, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN],
                                              names(sort(b, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN])))
}))
fwrite(loo, file.path(OUT, "outlier_exclusion_vs_main.csv"))

## ---- (3) Phenotype agreement across scenarios ----
ari <- function(a, b) {
  t <- table(a, b); n <- sum(t); s <- function(x) sum(choose(x, 2))
  e <- s(rowSums(t)) * s(colSums(t)) / choose(n, 2)
  (s(t) - e) / ((s(rowSums(t)) + s(colSums(t))) / 2 - e)
}
assign_main <- fread(file.path(RES, "main/05_patterns/patient_phenotypes_assignment.csv"))
k <- length(unique(assign_main$cluster))
pheno <- rbindlist(lapply(names(sc)[-1], function(s) {
  D <- sc[[s]]$D_raw[assign_main$patient, ]
  cl <- cutree(hclust(dist(sqrt(D / rowSums(D))), "ward.D2"), k)
  data.table(scenario = s, ARI_vs_main = ari(assign_main$cluster, cl),
             pct_same_assignment = 100 * max(mean(cl == assign_main$cluster), mean(cl == 3 - assign_main$cluster)))
}))
fwrite(pheno, file.path(OUT, "phenotype_agreement_scenarios.csv"))

## ---- Figure ----
p <- ggplot(sens, aes(x = feature_type, y = scenario, fill = cohort_rank_spearman)) +
  geom_tile() + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("rho=%.2f\ntop10=%d/10\npt-rho=%.2f", cohort_rank_spearman,
                                              top10_overlap, median_per_feature_patient_spearman)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 1)) + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Sensitivity of kernel patterns vs main analysis",
       subtitle = "rho: cohort-level ranking; top10: overlap of top-10; pt-rho: median per-feature patient-level Spearman")
save_plot(p, file.path(OUT, "fig_sensitivity_scenarios.pdf"), 10, 6)

cat("\n== Sensitivity scenarios ==\n"); print(sens, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Bootstrap top-10 stability ==\n"); print(boot_tab, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Outlier exclusion ==\n"); print(loo, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Phenotype agreement ==\n"); print(pheno, digits = 3)

  D <- read_feat(file.path(dir, "kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv"))
  E <- edge_fraction(kl)
  i <- which(kl$ct == colnames(kl$C)[1]); j <- which(kl$ct == colnames(kl$C)[2])
  chk <- unname(D[, paste0("Dir_", kl$ct[i], "_", kl$ct[j])]) - unname(E[i, j, ] + E[j, i, ])
  stopifnot(max(abs(chk)) < 1e-10)   # Cmatrix CSV order matches the kernel's cell types
  list(D_raw = D,
       D_norm = read_feat(file.path(dir, "kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
       W_raw = wedges(kl, FALSE), W_norm = wedges(kl, TRUE))
}

scen_dirs <- c(
  main = file.path(RES, "main"),
  S1_funLR_prod = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S1_funLR_prod"),
  S2_exprThr5 = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S2_exprThr5"),
  S3_exprThr20 = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S3_exprThr20"),
  S4_immuneOnly = file.path(RES, "sensitivity/S4_immuneOnly")
)
sc <- list()
sc$main <- {
  m <- file.path(RES, "main")
  kl <- load_kernel(file.path(m, "01_inputs"), file.path(m, "02_kernel_raw/result.rds"), file.path(m, "03_kernel_norm/result.rds"))
  list(D_raw = read_feat(file.path(m, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv")),
       D_norm = read_feat(file.path(m, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
       W_raw = wedges(kl, FALSE), W_norm = wedges(kl, TRUE))
}
for (s in names(scen_dirs)[-1]) sc[[s]] <- load_scenario(scen_dirs[[s]])

is_share <- function(ft) grepl("_raw$", ft)
cohort_stat <- function(X, ft) if (is_share(ft)) apply(X / rowSums(X), 2, median) else apply(X, 2, median)

## ---- (1) Sensitivity scenarios vs main ----
sens <- list()
for (s in names(sc)[-1]) for (ft in c("D_raw", "D_norm", "W_raw", "W_norm")) {
  A <- sc$main[[ft]]; B <- sc[[s]][[ft]]
  feats <- intersect(colnames(A), colnames(B))
  if (s == "S4_immuneOnly") feats <- feats[!grepl("Cancer", feats)]
  A <- A[, feats]; B <- B[rownames(A), feats]
  if (is_share(ft)) { A <- A / rowSums(A); B <- B / rowSums(B) }   # shares within the compared set
  a <- apply(A, 2, median); b <- apply(B, 2, median)
  topA <- names(sort(a, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN]; topB <- names(sort(b, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN]
  per_feat <- sapply(feats, function(f) suppressWarnings(cor(A[, f], B[, f], method = "spearman")))
  sens[[length(sens) + 1]] <- data.table(
    scenario = s, feature_type = ft, n_features_compared = length(feats),
    cohort_rank_spearman = cor(a, b, method = "spearman"),
    top10_overlap = length(intersect(topA, topB)),
    main_top3_ranks_in_scenario = paste(match(topA[1:3], names(sort(b, decreasing = TRUE))), collapse = ","),
    median_per_feature_patient_spearman = median(per_feat, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_features_patient_spearman_gt_0.8 = 100 * mean(per_feat > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE))
}
sens <- rbindlist(sens)
fwrite(sens, file.path(OUT, "sensitivity_scenarios_vs_main.csv"))

## ---- (2) Patient bootstrap and outlier exclusion (main analysis) ----
boot_tab <- list()
for (ft in c("D_raw", "D_norm", "W_raw", "W_norm")) {
  X <- sc$main[[ft]]
  if (!is_share(ft)) X <- X[, colMeans(X > 0) > 0.5]       # enrichment only where defined in most patients
  full <- cohort_stat(X, ft)
  top <- names(sort(full, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN]
  B <- replicate(1000, {
    st <- cohort_stat(X[sample(nrow(X), replace = TRUE), ], ft)
    r <- rank(-st, ties.method = "min")
    r[top]
  })
  rownames(B) <- top
  boot_tab[[ft]] <- data.table(feature_type = ft, feature = top, full_rank = 1:TOPN,
                               boot_median_rank = apply(B, 1, median),
                               boot_rank_95CI = apply(B, 1, function(r) paste(quantile(r, c(.025, .975)), collapse = "-")),
                               pct_boot_in_top10 = 100 * rowMeans(B <= TOPN),
                               pct_boot_same_rank = 100 * rowMeans(B == seq_len(TOPN)))
}
boot_tab <- rbindlist(boot_tab)
fwrite(boot_tab, file.path(OUT, "bootstrap_top10_stability.csv"))

outliers <- c("Gide_8_PD1_PRE",      # low library complexity (~4.6k genes > 1 TPM)
              "Gide_36_PD1_PRE",     # no tumor fraction, 65% neutrophils
              "Gide_33_ipiPD1_PRE")  # extreme raw triangle counts (rare NK)
loo <- rbindlist(lapply(c("D_raw", "D_norm", "W_raw", "W_norm"), function(ft) {
  X <- sc$main[[ft]]
  if (!is_share(ft)) X <- X[, colMeans(X > 0) > 0.5]
  a <- cohort_stat(X, ft); b <- cohort_stat(X[!rownames(X) %in% outliers, ], ft)
  data.table(feature_type = ft, cohort_rank_spearman = cor(a, b, method = "spearman"),
             top10_overlap = length(intersect(names(sort(a, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN],
                                              names(sort(b, decreasing = TRUE))[1:TOPN])))
}))
fwrite(loo, file.path(OUT, "outlier_exclusion_vs_main.csv"))

## ---- (3) Phenotype agreement across scenarios ----
ari <- function(a, b) {
  t <- table(a, b); n <- sum(t); s <- function(x) sum(choose(x, 2))
  e <- s(rowSums(t)) * s(colSums(t)) / choose(n, 2)
  (s(t) - e) / ((s(rowSums(t)) + s(colSums(t))) / 2 - e)
}
assign_main <- fread(file.path(RES, "main/05_patterns/patient_phenotypes_assignment.csv"))
k <- length(unique(assign_main$cluster))
pheno <- rbindlist(lapply(names(sc)[-1], function(s) {
  D <- sc[[s]]$D_raw[assign_main$patient, ]
  cl <- cutree(hclust(dist(sqrt(D / rowSums(D))), "ward.D2"), k)
  data.table(scenario = s, ARI_vs_main = ari(assign_main$cluster, cl),
             pct_same_assignment = 100 * max(mean(cl == assign_main$cluster), mean(cl == 3 - assign_main$cluster)))
}))
fwrite(pheno, file.path(OUT, "phenotype_agreement_scenarios.csv"))

## ---- Figure ----
p <- ggplot(sens, aes(x = feature_type, y = scenario, fill = cohort_rank_spearman)) +
  geom_tile() + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("rho=%.2f\ntop10=%d/10\npt-rho=%.2f", cohort_rank_spearman,
                                              top10_overlap, median_per_feature_patient_spearman)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 1)) + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Sensitivity of kernel patterns vs main analysis",
       subtitle = "rho: cohort-level ranking; top10: overlap of top-10; pt-rho: median per-feature patient-level Spearman")
save_plot(p, file.path(OUT, "fig_sensitivity_scenarios.pdf"), 10, 6)

cat("\n== Sensitivity scenarios ==\n"); print(sens, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Bootstrap top-10 stability ==\n"); print(boot_tab, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Outlier exclusion ==\n"); print(loo, digits = 3)
cat("\n== Phenotype agreement ==\n"); print(pheno, digits = 3)

# Most common cell-cell communication patterns in the Gide cohort, from the
# deterministic RaCInG kernel (main analysis: quanTIseq composition incl. tumor,
# 0.1% abundance floor, fun_LR = min, expr_threshold = 10 TPM).
source("/home/marcelo.hurtado/Documents/tme_analysis/78d8073c6b/work/results/scripts/common.R")
suppressMessages({
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cluster)
  library(patchwork)
})
set.seed(1)

M <- file.path(RES, "main")
OUT <- file.path(M, "05_patterns")
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE)

kl <- load_kernel(file.path(M, "01_inputs"),
                  file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result.rds"),
                  file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result.rds"))
coldata <- read.csv(file.path(RES, "inputs/Gide_coldata.csv"), row.names = 1)
coldata <- coldata[kl$patients, ]
ct <- kl$ct

## ---- Features (raw = abundance-weighted magnitude; norm = enrichment ratio) ----
feat <- list(
  raw = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = FALSE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  ),
  norm = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = TRUE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  )
)
# Kernel TT output holds trust triangles (TT_) and cycle triangles (CT_).
for (s in names(feat)) {
  tt <- feat[[s]]$TT
  feat[[s]]$TT <- tt[, grepl("^TT_", colnames(tt))]
  feat[[s]]$CT <- tt[, grepl("^CT_", colnames(tt))]
}
saveRDS(feat, file.path(OUT, "kernel_features_corrected.rds"))
for (s in names(feat)) for (f in names(feat[[s]]))
  fwrite(data.table(patient = rownames(feat[[s]][[f]]), feat[[s]][[f]]),
         file.path(OUT, sprintf("features_%s_%s.csv", s, f)))

## ---- Cohort-level summaries ----
summ <- list()
for (f in c("D", "W", "TT", "CT")) {
  a <- share_summary(feat$raw[[f]])
  b <- enrich_summary(feat$norm[[f]])
  setnames(b, c("q25", "q75"), c("enrich_q25", "enrich_q75"))
  m <- merge(a, b[, !"pct_patients_nonzero"], by = "feature", all = TRUE)
  m <- m[order(-median_share)]
  m[, rank_share := seq_len(.N)]
  summ[[f]] <- m
  fwrite(m, file.path(OUT, sprintf("cohort_summary_%s.csv", f)))
}

gscc <- feat$raw$GSCC
gscc_tab <- data.table(
  cell_type = sub("GSCC_", "", colnames(gscc)),
  median_fraction_in_GSCC = apply(gscc, 2, median),
  q25 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .25), q75 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .75),
  median_enrichment = apply(feat$norm$GSCC, 2, median),
  pct_patients_enriched = 100 * colMeans(feat$norm$GSCC > 1)
)[order(-median_fraction_in_GSCC)]
fwrite(gscc_tab, file.path(OUT, "cohort_summary_GSCC.csv"))

## ---- Cell-type roles ----
E <- edge_fraction(kl)
Eshare <- sweep(E, 3, apply(E, 3, sum), "/")
med_E <- apply(Eshare, 1:2, median)
fwrite(data.table(sender = rownames(med_E), med_E), file.path(OUT, "median_edge_share_sender_x_receiver.csv"))

Wraw <- feat$raw$W
hub <- sub("^W_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(Wraw))
Wsh <- Wraw / rowSums(Wraw)
hub_share <- sapply(ct, function(h) rowSums(Wsh[, hub == h, drop = FALSE]))
roles <- data.table(
  cell_type = ct,
  median_abundance = apply(kl$C, 2, median),
  median_out_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(1, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_in_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(2, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_relay_share = apply(hub_share, 2, median)
)
roles[, out_over_abundance := median_out_share / median_abundance]
roles[, in_over_abundance := median_in_share / median_abundance]
roles <- roles[order(-median_relay_share)]
fwrite(roles, file.path(OUT, "cell_type_roles.csv"))

## ---- Patient communication phenotypes (clustering on direct-edge shares) ----
Dsh <- feat$raw$D / rowSums(feat$raw$D)
H <- sqrt(Dsh)                          # Hellinger embedding of compositions
dH <- dist(H)
hc <- hclust(dH, method = "ward.D2")
sil <- sapply(2:6, function(k) mean(silhouette(cutree(hc, k), dH)[, 3]))
names(sil) <- 2:6
k_best <- as.integer(names(which.max(sil)))
cl <- cutree(hc, k_best)

# Bootstrap stability (clusterboot-style): resample patients, recluster, and
# record for each original cluster the best Jaccard match.
boot_jac <- replicate(200, {
  idx <- sort(unique(sample(seq_len(nrow(H)), replace = TRUE)))
  cb <- cutree(hclust(dist(H[idx, ]), method = "ward.D2"), k_best)
  sapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
    a <- idx[cl[idx] == g]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cb), function(h) {
      b <- idx[cb == h]
      length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
    }))
  })
})
boot_jac <- matrix(boot_jac, nrow = k_best)
clus_stab <- data.table(
  cluster = seq_len(k_best), n = as.integer(table(cl)),
  mean_jaccard = rowMeans(boot_jac, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_boot_jaccard_gt_0.75 = 100 * rowMeans(boot_jac > 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Characterize clusters: mean shares of top direct edges, composition, response.
top_edges <- summ$D$feature[1:12]
clus_desc <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
  w <- cl == g
  diffs <- colMeans(Dsh[w, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(Dsh[!w, , drop = FALSE])
  data.table(cluster = g,
             defining_edges_up = paste(names(sort(diffs, decreasing = TRUE))[1:4], collapse = "; "),
             top_abundant = paste(names(sort(colMeans(kl$C[w, , drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = "; "),
             median_tumor_fraction = median(kl$C[w, "Cancer"]),
             n_R = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "R"), n_NR = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "NR"))
}))
clus_desc <- merge(clus_stab, clus_desc, by = "cluster")
fwrite(clus_desc, file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_clusters.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(patient = names(cl), original_id = coldata$original_id, cluster = cl,
                  Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy),
       file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_assignment.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(k = 2:6, mean_silhouette = sil), file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_silhouette.csv"))
resp_p <- fisher.test(table(cl, coldata$Response))$p.value

## ---- Figures ----
lab <- function(x) gsub("_", " - ", sub("^(Dir|W|TT|CT)_", "", x))

topD <- summ$D[1:15]
p1 <- ggplot(topD, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of patient's direct communication (median, IQR)",
       title = "Dominant direct interactions (raw kernel)")
enr <- summ$D[pct_patients_nonzero > 50][order(-median_enrichment)][1:15]

# Most common cell-cell communication patterns in the Gide cohort, from the
# deterministic RaCInG kernel (main analysis: quanTIseq composition incl. tumor,
# 0.1% abundance floor, fun_LR = min, expr_threshold = 10 TPM).
source("/home/marcelo.hurtado/Documents/tme_analysis/78d8073c6b/work/results/scripts/common.R")
suppressMessages({
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cluster)
  library(patchwork)
})
set.seed(1)

M <- file.path(RES, "main")
OUT <- file.path(M, "05_patterns")
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE)

kl <- load_kernel(file.path(M, "01_inputs"),
                  file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result.rds"),
                  file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result.rds"))
coldata <- read.csv(file.path(RES, "inputs/Gide_coldata.csv"), row.names = 1)
coldata <- coldata[kl$patients, ]
ct <- kl$ct

## ---- Features (raw = abundance-weighted magnitude; norm = enrichment ratio) ----
feat <- list(
  raw = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = FALSE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "02_kernel_raw/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  ),
  norm = list(
    D = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_D.csv")),
    W = wedges(kl, norm = TRUE),
    TT = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_TT.csv")),
    GSCC = read_feat(file.path(M, "03_kernel_norm/result_features_GSCC.csv"))
  )
)
# Kernel TT output holds trust triangles (TT_) and cycle triangles (CT_).
for (s in names(feat)) {
  tt <- feat[[s]]$TT
  feat[[s]]$TT <- tt[, grepl("^TT_", colnames(tt))]
  feat[[s]]$CT <- tt[, grepl("^CT_", colnames(tt))]
}
saveRDS(feat, file.path(OUT, "kernel_features_corrected.rds"))
for (s in names(feat)) for (f in names(feat[[s]]))
  fwrite(data.table(patient = rownames(feat[[s]][[f]]), feat[[s]][[f]]),
         file.path(OUT, sprintf("features_%s_%s.csv", s, f)))

## ---- Cohort-level summaries ----
summ <- list()
for (f in c("D", "W", "TT", "CT")) {
  a <- share_summary(feat$raw[[f]])
  b <- enrich_summary(feat$norm[[f]])
  setnames(b, c("q25", "q75"), c("enrich_q25", "enrich_q75"))
  m <- merge(a, b[, !"pct_patients_nonzero"], by = "feature", all = TRUE)
  m <- m[order(-median_share)]
  m[, rank_share := seq_len(.N)]
  summ[[f]] <- m
  fwrite(m, file.path(OUT, sprintf("cohort_summary_%s.csv", f)))
}

gscc <- feat$raw$GSCC
gscc_tab <- data.table(
  cell_type = sub("GSCC_", "", colnames(gscc)),
  median_fraction_in_GSCC = apply(gscc, 2, median),
  q25 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .25), q75 = apply(gscc, 2, quantile, .75),
  median_enrichment = apply(feat$norm$GSCC, 2, median),
  pct_patients_enriched = 100 * colMeans(feat$norm$GSCC > 1)
)[order(-median_fraction_in_GSCC)]
fwrite(gscc_tab, file.path(OUT, "cohort_summary_GSCC.csv"))

## ---- Cell-type roles ----
E <- edge_fraction(kl)
Eshare <- sweep(E, 3, apply(E, 3, sum), "/")
med_E <- apply(Eshare, 1:2, median)
fwrite(data.table(sender = rownames(med_E), med_E), file.path(OUT, "median_edge_share_sender_x_receiver.csv"))

Wraw <- feat$raw$W
hub <- sub("^W_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(Wraw))
Wsh <- Wraw / rowSums(Wraw)
hub_share <- sapply(ct, function(h) rowSums(Wsh[, hub == h, drop = FALSE]))
roles <- data.table(
  cell_type = ct,
  median_abundance = apply(kl$C, 2, median),
  median_out_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(1, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_in_share = apply(apply(Eshare, c(2, 3), sum), 1, median),
  median_relay_share = apply(hub_share, 2, median)
)
roles[, out_over_abundance := median_out_share / median_abundance]
roles[, in_over_abundance := median_in_share / median_abundance]
roles <- roles[order(-median_relay_share)]
fwrite(roles, file.path(OUT, "cell_type_roles.csv"))

## ---- Patient communication phenotypes (clustering on direct-edge shares) ----
Dsh <- feat$raw$D / rowSums(feat$raw$D)
H <- sqrt(Dsh)                          # Hellinger embedding of compositions
dH <- dist(H)
hc <- hclust(dH, method = "ward.D2")
sil <- sapply(2:6, function(k) mean(silhouette(cutree(hc, k), dH)[, 3]))
names(sil) <- 2:6
k_best <- as.integer(names(which.max(sil)))
cl <- cutree(hc, k_best)

# Bootstrap stability (clusterboot-style): resample patients, recluster, and
# record for each original cluster the best Jaccard match.
boot_jac <- replicate(200, {
  idx <- sort(unique(sample(seq_len(nrow(H)), replace = TRUE)))
  cb <- cutree(hclust(dist(H[idx, ]), method = "ward.D2"), k_best)
  sapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
    a <- idx[cl[idx] == g]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cb), function(h) {
      b <- idx[cb == h]
      length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
    }))
  })
})
boot_jac <- matrix(boot_jac, nrow = k_best)
clus_stab <- data.table(
  cluster = seq_len(k_best), n = as.integer(table(cl)),
  mean_jaccard = rowMeans(boot_jac, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_boot_jaccard_gt_0.75 = 100 * rowMeans(boot_jac > 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Characterize clusters: mean shares of top direct edges, composition, response.
top_edges <- summ$D$feature[1:12]
clus_desc <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(k_best), function(g) {
  w <- cl == g
  diffs <- colMeans(Dsh[w, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(Dsh[!w, , drop = FALSE])
  data.table(cluster = g,
             defining_edges_up = paste(names(sort(diffs, decreasing = TRUE))[1:4], collapse = "; "),
             top_abundant = paste(names(sort(colMeans(kl$C[w, , drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3], collapse = "; "),
             median_tumor_fraction = median(kl$C[w, "Cancer"]),
             n_R = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "R"), n_NR = sum(coldata$Response[w] == "NR"))
}))
clus_desc <- merge(clus_stab, clus_desc, by = "cluster")
fwrite(clus_desc, file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_clusters.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(patient = names(cl), original_id = coldata$original_id, cluster = cl,
                  Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy),
       file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_assignment.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(k = 2:6, mean_silhouette = sil), file.path(OUT, "patient_phenotypes_silhouette.csv"))
resp_p <- fisher.test(table(cl, coldata$Response))$p.value

# The clusters cut a continuum: the main axis of variation (PC1 of the same
# Hellinger embedding) is reported as the patient-level pattern.
pca <- prcomp(H)
axis_var <- 100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:3]
pc1 <- pca$x[, 1]
if (cor(pc1, Dsh[, "Dir_Mono_Mono"]) < 0) { pc1 <- -pc1; pca$rotation[, 1] <- -pca$rotation[, 1] }
fwrite(data.table(patient = names(pc1), original_id = coldata$original_id,
                  neutro_to_mono_axis_PC1 = pc1, cluster = cl, Response = coldata$Response),
       file.path(OUT, "patient_axis_PC1_scores.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(feature = rownames(pca$rotation), PC1_loading = pca$rotation[, 1])[order(PC1_loading)],
       file.path(OUT, "patient_axis_PC1_loadings.csv"))
saveRDS(pca, file.path(OUT, "patient_axis_pca.rds"))
axis_resp_p <- wilcox.test(pc1 ~ coldata$Response)$p.value

## ---- Figures ----
lab <- function(x) gsub("_", " - ", sub("^(Dir|W|TT|CT)_", "", x))

topD <- summ$D[1:15]
p1 <- ggplot(topD, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of patient's direct communication (median, IQR)",
       title = "Dominant direct interactions (raw kernel)")
enr <- summ$D[pct_patients_nonzero > 50][order(-median_enrichment)][1:15]
p2 <- ggplot(enr, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_enrichment), y = median_enrichment)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = enrich_q25, ymax = enrich_q75), width = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Enrichment over uniform-LR baseline (median, IQR)",
       title = "Most specific direct interactions (normalized kernel)")
save_plot(p1 + p2, file.path(OUT, "fig_direct_top_interactions.pdf"), 14, 6)

pdf(file.path(OUT, "fig_sender_receiver_median_edge_share.pdf"), 7, 6)
pheatmap(100 * med_E, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.1f", main = "Median % of communication edges (row = sender, col = receiver)")
dev.off()

topW <- summ$W[1:15]
p3 <- ggplot(topW, aes(x = reorder(lab(feature), median_share), y = 100 * median_share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "seagreen") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * q25, ymax = 100 * q75), width = .3) +
  coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "leaf - hub - leaf", y = "% of patient's wedges (median, IQR)", title = "Dominant relays (wedges)")
rl <- melt(roles[, .(cell_type, median_abundance, median_out_share, median_in_share, median_relay_share)],
           id.vars = "cell_type")
p4 <- ggplot(rl, aes(x = reorder(cell_type, value), y = 100 * value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% (cohort median)", fill = NULL, title = "Cell-type roles")
save_plot(p3 + p4, file.path(OUT, "fig_wedges_and_roles.pdf"), 14, 6)

ann <- data.frame(Phenotype = factor(cl), Response = coldata$Response, Therapy = coldata$Therapy,
                  row.names = names(cl))
pdf(file.path(OUT, "fig_patient_phenotypes_heatmap.pdf"), 12, 11)
pheatmap(t(100 * Dsh[, summ$D$feature[1:25]]), cluster_cols = hc, cutree_cols = k_best,
         annotation_col = ann, labels_row = lab(summ$D$feature[1:25]), show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = sprintf("Direct-communication profiles (%% of patient total), k=%d phenotypes", k_best))
dev.off()

## ---- Console report ----
cat("\n== Top direct interactions (share of patient's direct communication) ==\n")
print(summ$D[1:12, .(feature, median_share = round(100 * median_share, 1),
                     pct_top5 = round(pct_patients_top5), median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2),
                     pct_enriched = round(pct_patients_enriched))])
cat("\n== Most enriched direct interactions (nonzero in >50% patients) ==\n")
print(enr[1:12, .(feature, median_enrichment = round(median_enrichment, 2),

boot_axis <- replicate(500, {
  p <- prcomp(Hm[sample(nrow(Hm), replace = TRUE), ])
  abs(cor(predict(p, Hm)[, 1], pc1_main$neutro_to_mono_axis_PC1, method = "spearman"))
})
